whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Downtown La Pasteleria,

I noticed your bakery has strong 4.6★ reviews near Patliputra Sports Complex in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online cake orders and custom inquiries.

Maine aapki pasteleria ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake booking, signature menu showcase, aur instant directions integrate ki hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/lapasteleria

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Downtown La Pasteleria team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp cake ordering and mobile-first menu display for your Kankarbagh location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact cakes/pastries, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
